senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גדל II) pl. גְּדִילִים, גְּדִילִין twisted threads, fringes, v. צִיצִית.
units: Men. 39ᵇ; Yeb. 5ᵇ גדיל שנים ג׳ ארבעה gadil (a twist) means at least two threads, g’dilim means four threads (which doubled make eight).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 57b:9">B. Bath. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>שני שלישי ג׳</he> … <he>גלוי וכ׳</he> Ar. a. Ms. O. (ed. <he>גלאי</he>) two thirds of the width of the table covered and one third uncovered for putting on dishes and vegetables.
